next_step: POC results review + cost model from AE; schedule architecture deep-dive with infra team
overview: Mid-market analytics SaaS evaluating Redwood Hosted as a lift-and-shift step from current LLM provider with eventual move to Dedicated. Primary goal: match existing prompt behavior and latency while reducing per-token cost and keeping data residency and SSO constraints.
notes: 2024-11-12 - inbound trial request from engineering lead (Ava Martinez). AE Maya intro call scheduled.

2024-11-19 - discovery call: product teams (search + chat) currently on third-party API (rate-limited). Pain: unpredictable tails on latency and rising token cost. Interested in Redwood billing model and dedicated pools.
2024-12-05 - demo with basic Hosted API walkthrough (ff_2024-12-05_qa-demo). SE Liam did live prompt demo; customer liked streaming + function-calling support.

2024-12-12 - POC kicked off: two-week hosted POC to validate prompt parity and embedding quality. Drive notes: drive://NebulaQuay/Redwood-POC-Notes. POC dataset: 12k chat transcripts + FAQ corpus (~800k tokens).

2024-12-18 - initial regression tests: small deviations in summarization brevity vs current provider. Customer test harness flags 34 failing prompts (mostly tone and truncation). SE working on temperature + decoding params.

2025-01-07 - migration kickoff (ff_2025-01-10_migration-kickoff scheduled). Discussed compatibility layer options: wrapper to translate existing OpenAI-style calls to Redwood endpoints; desire minimal SDK changes.

2025-01-10 - architecture call with infra (Liam, Maya, NebulaQuay infra lead Raj): plan for Hosted -> Dedicated runway: start on Hosted to validate prompts, then reserve Dedicated pool (1-2 cards) tied to VPC for data residency.
Technical asks from NebulaQuay:
- Exact replication of function-calling semantics and response schema (they rely on existing toolchain).
- Prompt templating parity: must preserve dynamic slot filling and stop-sequence behavior used in product search ranking.
- Latency SLO: p95 < 220ms for chat-inference (short context ~512 tokens).
- Throughput: ~120 concurrent users, baseline 3 RPS sustained, spikes to 12 RPS for promos.
POC findings so far:
- Embeddings quality: cosine recall within 2% of incumbent on internal eval (good).
- Token-cost: Hosted hosted-api quote shows ~18% lower token price vs current provider for their workload pattern (batching + caching improvements).
- Regression flag: reranker top-1 differs on 9% of key queries — customer worried about UX regressions. Need focused prompt/eval iteration.
Security/compliance notes:
- Require SSO/SAML integration before Dedicated go-live. Legal needs data residency addendum for EU customers.
- KMS integration required for on-disk keys on Dedicated nodes (customer policy).
Commercials / pricing conversations:
- AE provided Dedicated starter pricing (1 GPU reserved) and hosted credits for POC. Drive: drive://NebulaQuay/Cost-Comparison-Deck.
- Customer asked for ARR band estimate: expecting $120k-$250k committed if Dedicated meets parity.
Next steps (short):
- 2025-01-20: POC final report deliverable from SE with per-prompt diffs and recommended prompt tweaks.
- AE to share Dedicated contract template + SLA addendum for review by legal (target: 2025-02-01).
- Engineering deep-dive: demonstrate compat-layer adapter code (OpenAI->Redwood shim) and run smoke tests on function-calling parity.
Customer quotes / tone:
- 'We want minimal product changes — can we keep the same SDK calls?' (product lead).
- 'Cost savings are attractive but only if UX doesn't regress.' (VP Eng).
Open questions pending:
- How extensive will rewriting prompts be for parity? Quick fixes vs design changes.
- Timeline for SAML connector in Dedicated onboarding (legal-heavy).
Internal notes for AE/SE:
- Prioritize a short checklist for POC: stop-sequence parity, function-calling schema, tokenization differences, embedding dimensionality check.
- Raise REDW-1102 if any regression blocks rollout (linking ticket).
- Suggested play: propose 30-day overlap on Hosted + Dedicated warm-up to allow gradual cutover and A/B rollback window.
Status summary: POC in progress on Hosted; technical regression items identified but addressable; procurement dependent on legal/data-residency sign-off and SAML timeline.
